desc: Write Python solution: parse N and A, compute sum_A for T_0.
Precompute v2(A_i) for each A_i and build arrays count_by_v, sum_by_v for diagonal contributions.
Compute suffix sums on sum_by_v to answer diagonal sum for each t >= 1 in O(1) per t.
Determine t_max as max t with (1 << t) <= 2 * max_A.
For each t in 1..t_max: build residue dict (residue -> [count, sum]) over all A_i, compute off-diagonal sum with the pairing rules, combine with diagonal contribution to get T_t.
Compute Answer = T_0 - sum((T_t >> t) for t in 1..t_max) and print it.
Test the solution on the provided sample inputs (2; 4 8 → 5, 3; 51 44 63 → 384, 8; given numbers → 20241214) and verify correctness and performance.
